head.architecture: LayerNorm(1024) -> Linear(1024,256) -> GELU -> Linear(256,128) -> L2 normalization

loss.positive_rule: For each positive anchor, optimize against its least-similar other physical-instance view.
loss.hierarchy: same physical door > same-scene different door > ordinary different-class instance

selection.split: Only the three manifest-frozen validation families may select an epoch.
selection.order: Lexicographically maximize validation ranking accuracy, positive-hard accuracy, hierarchy accuracy, mean positive-hard gap, mean hard-ordinary gap, then prefer the earliest epoch.
selection.final_heldout_access: Forbidden during training and epoch selection.

gate.requirements: Validation ranking accuracy must not decrease, and both mean positive-hard and mean hard-ordinary gaps must strictly improve over raw DINOv2.

next_action: Keep the raw DINOv2 baseline and open a new Development protocol for foreground patch pooling; do not inspect final heldout families.
claim_boundary: This is target-family-disjoint Development train/validation only. Even a positive gate establishes neither final heldout proposal reranking nor portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety.
